The concept for this innovative theater production is titled "The Chorus of Choice." It reimagines Sophocles' *Antigone* by transforming the traditional amphitheater into a labyrinthine, multi-room set where the audience moves freely. Instead of a static stage, the dramatic monologues of Antigone, Creon, and Haemon are delivered in intimate, one-on-one encounters or small group settings. Spectators are not passive observers but active participants who must choose which character to follow, effectively becoming the "Chorus" that influences the narrative flow through their physical presence and whispered counsel. This fusion allows the audience to experience the weight of tragic fate and moral dilemma firsthand, as their engagement subtly alters the pacing and emotional intensity of the classical text.
